judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass House Bill 147, which barred Alabama cities from starting new taxes on what people earn at work. No municipality may impose an occupational or license tax on a person's trade or profession unless the Legislature passes a law for that city by name. Every such tax already in place before February 2020 is untouched, and ordinary business license taxes are not affected. The House passed it 74-27 and it became law.
